Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Anna keeps a small panda at home and feeds it every morning. On Sunday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. The skipper checked the sails before departure.

Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The experience taught Anna more than any book could. The running track has become an important part of daily life. In fact, my childhood teddy bear seems completely indestructible after all these years.

People around Anna often share different ideas about the swimming pool. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. In fact, stand up slowly to avoid dizziness.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Anna is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. Anna's dream job is to be a engineer. The bakery's storefront was painted bright yellow.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Little by little, things began to change.
